visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a building exterior featuring a modern, textured wall with diagonal grey and beige slats and large glass doors. (2) The camera transitions to a shot of interior carpeted stairs with gold-colored metal handrails and white marble bases, leading up to a dining area. (3) A wide panning shot reveals a spacious restaurant interior with large floor-to-ceiling windows showing green trees outdoors; a lone female customer sits at a distant table; the furniture consists of dark wooden tables and green velvet chairs under warm, low lighting. (4) A series of rapid close-up shots showcase various dishes: a hand pours green oil over shrimp and tomatoes, a fork picks up a slice of ham from a salad, a spoon lifts smooth yellow pumpkin soup, and a fork twirls tomato-based pasta. (5) The final sequence shows a person pouring white liquid from a teapot into a cup, followed by a wide nighttime exterior shot of the tall hotel building with large text overlays displaying restaurant information.

(25) [Logo]: 艾可廚坊 (帕可麗酒店Park Lees Hotel) 地址 高雄市鼓山區文信路192號2樓. (26) [Slogan]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (27) [Slogan]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
